Path Planning of Low-Altitude UAV for Tree Canopy Tracking and Orchard Monitoring

Kaushal Kishore1 and Ritabrata Chakraborty2

1CSIR-Central Electronics Engineering Research Institute (CSIR-CEERI), Pilani, Rajasthan, India

2Birla Institute of Technology and Science (BITS) Pilani, Rajasthan, India

Preprint, 20 October 2026 · Supported by CSIR-CEERI, Pilani

Request Paper Code Demo Cite

Abstract

Orchards are planted in long parallel rows, so a monitoring UAV must lock onto one treeline and follow it without drifting to a neighboring row. This paper presents a monocular, onboard pipeline that does this from canopy appearance alone. A forward-facing camera tilted 45° downward feeds a YOLOv11 instance-segmentation model trained on a new olive-orchard dataset (290 annotated images captured in Pilani, India). Gaussian Soft-NMS keeps adjacent treelines as separate instances where they converge near the image edges, a Kalman filter keeps the selected row locked across frames, and a line fitted through the center points of the refined canopy mask gives the navigation line. Its horizontal offset and slope set the roll and yaw commands, while pitch is held constant. On the custom dataset, YOLOv11 reaches a box mAP@50 of 95.5% and a mask mAP@50 of 96.5%, ahead of YolactEdge and YOLACT++. With TensorRT optimization the pipeline runs at 17 frames per second on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX. In field tests over the Pilani olive orchard, the quadcopter generated and followed navigation lines autonomously and remained stable under small wind disturbances.

Keywords: Precision Agriculture, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs), Orchard Monitoring, Treeline Tracking, Instance Segmentation, YOLOv11, Soft-NMS, Kalman Filter, Visual Servoing, Edge Computing

Key results

96.5mask mAP50 of YOLOv11 on the orchard dataset
95.5box mAP50, ahead of YolactEdge (73.2) and YOLACT++ (69.7)
17 FPSonboard on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX with TensorRT
290annotated images from an olive orchard in Pilani, Rajasthan

Paper

  • Full paper (PDF), shared on request via Google Drive: problem statement and system overview, the olive-orchard dataset, the segmentation, Soft-NMS, Kalman tracking and navigation-line methods, the control law, and the segmentation, runtime and field-trial results.
  • Code for the full pipeline, with the trained canopy segmentation checkpoint.

Code

The repository contains the inference pipeline with an interactive interface, Kalman tracking, post-processing and control modules, training and TensorRT export scripts, a Jetson Orin environment, and the trained canopy segmentation checkpoint.

git clone https://github.com/Ritabrata-Chakraborty/Monocular-Vision-Based-UAV-Navigation-for-Orchard-Monitoring.git
cd Monocular-Vision-Based-UAV-Navigation-for-Orchard-Monitoring
pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/run_inference.py --ui --video 0
